sn35.80:1.1: atha kho aññataro bhikkhu yena bhagavā tenupasaṅkami …pe… ekamantaṃ nisinno kho so bhikkhu bhagavantaṃ etadavoca:
sn35.80:1.2: atthi nu kho bhante, eko dhammo yassa pahāṇā bhikkhuno avijjā pahīyati vijjā uppajjatīti.
sn35.80:2.1: atthi kho bhikkhu eko dhammo yassa pahāṇā bhikkhuno avijjā pahīyati vijjā uppajjatīti.
sn35.80:3.1: katamo pana bhante, eko dhammo yassa pahāṇā bhikkhuno avijjā pahīyati vijjā uppajjatīti.
sn35.80:4.1: avijjā kho bhikkhu eko dhammo yassa pahāṇā bhikkhuno avijjā pahīyati, vijjā uppajjatīti.
sn35.80:5.1: kathampana bhante, jānato kathaṃ passato avijjā pahīyati vijjā uppajjatīti?
sn35.80:6.5: so sabbaṃ dhammaṃ abhijānāti, sabbaṃ dhammaṃ abhiññāya sabbaṃ dhammaṃ parijānāti sabbaṃ dhammaṃ pariññāya sabbanimittāni aññato passati, cakkhuṃ aññato passati, rūpe aññato passati,
sn35.80:6.8: yampidaṃ cakkhusamphassapaccayā uppajjati sukhaṃ vā dukkhaṃ vā adukkhamasukhaṃ vā tampi aññato passati …pe…
sn35.80:6.12: yampidaṃ mano samphassapaccayā uppajjati vedayitaṃ sukhaṃ vā dukkhaṃ vā adukkhamasukhaṃ vā. tampi aññato passati
sn35.80:6.13: evaṃ kho bhikkhu jānato evaṃ passato bhikkhuno avijjā pahīyati vijjā uppajjatīti.
